source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
exam_appearance: SSC Gap Filling with Preposition (likely from Board Question patterns)
passage: Every student wants to do well in the examination. But it is not an easy task. A student has to work hard (a) _____ this. From the very beginning (b) _____ the year, he must be serious. He should read the text books again and again. He must not memorize answers (c) _____ understanding. He must not make note (d) _____ a common source. He should have a good command (e) _____ English. By doing all these things, a student can hope to make an excellent result.

blanks.explanation_en: We use 'work hard for' something (an exam, a goal). It means putting effort to achieve it. 'At' is used for a point, 'on' for a surface, 'in' for a place – none fit here.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'work hard for' ব্যবহৃত হয় কোনো কিছু (পরীক্ষা, লক্ষ্য) অর্জনের জন্য চেষ্টা বোঝাতে। 'at' কোনো বিন্দু, 'on' পৃষ্ঠ, 'in' স্থান বোঝায় – এখানে মানায় না।

blanks.explanation_en: 'Beginning of the year' is a fixed part‑whole relationship. 'From' indicates starting point, 'since' for a point in time, 'off' means away – incorrect.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'Beginning of the year' একটি নির্দিষ্ট অংশ-সম্পর্ক। 'from' শুরু বিন্দু, 'since' সময়ের বিন্দু, 'off' দূরে বোঝায় – ভুল।

blanks.explanation_en: Memorizing 'without' understanding means no comprehension. 'With' would give opposite meaning, 'by' indicates method, 'for' purpose – not suitable.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'without understanding' অর্থ বোঝা ছাড়া। 'with' দিলে উল্টো অর্থ হয়, 'by' পদ্ধতি, 'for' উদ্দেশ্য – মানায় না।

blanks.explanation_en: We make notes 'from' a source – we take information out of that source. 'Of' shows possession, 'by' agent, 'with' accompaniment – wrong.
blanks.explanation_bn: আমরা কোনো উৎস 'থেকে' (from) নোট তৈরি করি – তথ্য গ্রহণ করি। 'of' মালিকানা, 'by' কর্তা, 'with' সহযোগিতা বোঝায় – ভুল।

blanks.explanation_en: 'Command of a language' means mastery. 'In' is used for field (command in battle), 'over' for authority, 'on' for topic – incorrect here.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'Command of a language' অর্থ ভাষায় দক্ষতা। 'in' যুদ্ধে কমান্ড, 'over' কর্তৃত্ব, 'on' বিষয় – এখানে ভুল।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Man is the architect (a) _____ his own fate. If he makes a proper division (b) _____ time and does his duties accordingly, he is sure to improve and prosper (c) _____ life. But if he does not do it, he is sure to repent. Then he will be bound to drag a miserable life. To spoil time is suicidal (d) _____ a person. For, our life is nothing but the sum total (e) _____ hours, days and years.

blanks.explanation_en: Architect 'of' his own fate – shows possession/relationship. 'For' indicates purpose, 'to' direction, 'in' location – all wrong.
blanks.explanation_bn: Architect 'of' his own fate – মালিকানা/সম্পর্ক বোঝায়। 'for' উদ্দেশ্য, 'to' দিক, 'in' অবস্থান – সব ভুল।

blanks.explanation_en: 'Division of time' – partitive use (dividing time into parts). 'Among' for >2, 'between' for two, 'with' accompaniment – not appropriate.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'Division of time' – ভাগ বোঝাতে of। 'among' দুইয়ের বেশি, 'between' দুইটির মধ্যে, 'with' সহযোগিতা – মানায় না।

blanks.explanation_en: Prosper 'in' life – 'in' is used for areas of activity or condition. 'At' point, 'on' surface, 'for' duration – incorrect.
blanks.explanation_bn: Prosper 'in' life – 'in' ব্যবহৃত হয় কর্মক্ষেত্র বা অবস্থায়। 'at' বিন্দু, 'on' পৃষ্ঠ, 'for' সময়কাল – ভুল।

blanks.explanation_en: Suicidal 'for' a person – indicates effect on that person. 'To' can indicate result but less common here, 'of' possession, 'with' accompaniment.
blanks.explanation_bn: Suicidal 'for' a person – সেই ব্যক্তির উপর প্রভাব বোঝায়। 'to' ফলাফল তবে কম প্রচলিত, 'of' মালিকানা, 'with' সহযোগিতা।

blanks.explanation_en: Sum total 'of' hours – partitive/genitive. 'About' means concerning, 'from' origin, 'in' inside – wrong.
blanks.explanation_bn: Sum total 'of' hours – অংশ/সম্বন্ধ বোঝায়। 'about' সম্পর্কে, 'from' উৎস, 'in' ভিতরে – ভুল।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: A great number of people speak English all (a) _____ the world. Some people use it as a first language and some people take it as a second language. Many international organizations now depend on English to communicate (b) _____ offices in different countries. Their advertisements published (c) _____ different newspapers are in English. They also want people who possess a good command (d) _____ English. People seeking job can't expect to get a good one (e) _____ knowing English.

blanks.explanation_en: 'All over the world' means everywhere. 'Around' is also possible but 'over' is the fixed phrase. 'Across' implies crossing, 'in' is too narrow.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'All over the world' অর্থ সারা বিশ্বে। 'around' সম্ভব তবে 'over' স্থির phrase। 'across' পার হওয়া, 'in' সংকীর্ণ।

blanks.explanation_en: Communicate 'with' someone/office. 'To' is used for communicate something to, but 'with' for two‑way exchange.
blanks.explanation_bn: Communicate 'with' – কারো সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ। 'to' কিছু জানাতে, কিন্তু 'with' দ্বিমুখী বিনিময়ের জন্য।

blanks.explanation_en: Published 'in' newspapers – 'in' is used for print media. 'On' is for online/on a page, 'at' for point, 'by' agent.
blanks.explanation_bn: Published 'in' newspapers – মুদ্রিত মাধ্যমে 'in' ব্যবহৃত হয়। 'on' অনলাইন/পাতায়, 'at' বিন্দু, 'by' কর্তা।

blanks.explanation_en: Command 'of' English – same as question 1(e). Mastery of a language.
blanks.explanation_bn: Command 'of' English – প্রশ্ন ১(e) এর মতো। ভাষায় দক্ষতা।

blanks.explanation_en: Can't expect ... 'without' knowing English – condition lacking. 'With' would reverse meaning.
blanks.explanation_bn: Can't expect ... 'without' knowing English – শর্তহীনতা। 'with' দিলে অর্থ উল্টে যায়।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: The Eiffel Tower was named (a) _____ Gustave Eiffel, a Frenchmen who build the Tower. He graduated from the Central School of Engineering in Paris and went to work for a railway construction company. For years Gustave made plan after plan (b) _____ dams, factories, stations and structures of great size. All (c) _____ Europe engineers copied them. In the middle of 1880s a group of French industrialists persuaded the government to organize a World's Fair in Paris. Gustave Eiffel proposed a 989-foot tower of iron as symbol of the fair. Forty engineers and designers (d) _____ Eiffel's supervision worked for two years. It was the highest structure yet made (e) _____ man.

blanks.explanation_en: Named 'after' someone – means given the same name in honour. 'By' would indicate agent (named by him) – incorrect.
blanks.explanation_bn: Named 'after' someone – কারো নামে নামকরণ। 'by' কর্তা বোঝায় (তার দ্বারা নামকরণ) – ভুল।

blanks.explanation_en: Plans 'of' dams – plans that describe or are for dams. 'For' is also possible, but 'of' is common in this structure.
blanks.explanation_bn: Plans 'of' dams – বাঁধের পরিকল্পনা। 'for' সম্ভব, তবে 'of' বেশি প্রচলিত।

blanks.explanation_en: All over Europe = throughout Europe. 'All over' is a fixed phrase for distribution.
blanks.explanation_bn: All over Europe = সারা ইউরোপে। 'All over' একটি স্থির phrase।

blanks.explanation_en: Worked 'under' supervision – meaning guided by. 'By' would be agent, 'in' location, 'with' accompaniment.
blanks.explanation_bn: Worked 'under' supervision – তত্ত্বাবধানে। 'by' কর্তা, 'in' অবস্থান, 'with' সহযোগিতা।

blanks.explanation_en: Made 'by' man – agent in passive voice. 'Of' material, 'from' origin, 'with' instrument.
blanks.explanation_bn: Made 'by' man – passive voice-এ কর্তা। 'of' উপাদান, 'from' উৎস, 'with' যন্ত্র।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: A man (a) _____ letters is respected always even after his death (b) _____ his deeds. He is an enlightened person who devotes himself (c) _____ a view to spreading education (d) _____ the society. He always teaches people how to differentiate (e) _____ right and wrong. In fact he is the authentic person whom the world should follow.

blanks.explanation_en: A man 'of' letters = a learned/educated person. Fixed expression.
blanks.explanation_bn: A man 'of' letters = বিদ্বান ব্যক্তি। স্থির phrase।

blanks.explanation_en: Respected 'for' his deeds – reason for respect. 'By' would be agent (respected by deeds – odd), 'with' accompaniment.
blanks.explanation_bn: Respected 'for' his deeds – কর্মের জন্য সম্মান। 'by' কর্তা (কর্ম দ্বারা সম্মানিত – অদ্ভুত), 'with' সহযোগিতা।

blanks.explanation_en: Devotes himself 'with' a view to – actually 'with a view to' is a phrase meaning 'with the intention of'. 'To' alone would be 'devotes himself to'.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'Devotes himself with a view to' – 'with a view to' মানে 'উদ্দেশ্যে'। শুধু 'to' দিলে 'devotes himself to' হয়।

blanks.explanation_en: Spreading education 'in' the society – within the bounds of society. 'Throughout' is also possible but 'in' is simpler.
blanks.explanation_bn: Spreading education 'in' the society – সমাজের মধ্যে। 'throughout' সম্ভব তবে 'in' সহজ।

blanks.explanation_en: Differentiate 'between' right and wrong – two items. 'Among' for more than two.
blanks.explanation_bn: Differentiate 'between' right and wrong – দুইটির মধ্যে পার্থক্য। 'among' দুইয়ের বেশি জন্য।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Trees bear a great impact on the climate. If we destroy trees (a) _____ random, one day the country will turn (b) _____ a great desert. The country will bear the consequences of greenhouse effect. Again there will be no rain and as a result the country will face a great crises because ours is an agricultural country and our economy is dependent (c) _____ agriculture. Again our agriculture depends on rain. So trees have a great effect (d) _____ our climate. Trees keep the soil strong. Trees save us (e) _____ flood and many other natural calamities.

blanks.explanation_en: 'At random' is a fixed phrase meaning without purpose. Others do not form this idiom.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'At random' একটি স্থির phrase, অর্থ উদ্দেশ্যহীনভাবে। অন্যগুলো এই idiom গঠন করে না।

blanks.explanation_en: Turn 'into' = change into something else. 'To' indicates direction, not transformation.
blanks.explanation_bn: Turn 'into' = রূপান্তরিত হওয়া। 'to' দিক নির্দেশ করে, রূপান্তর নয়।

blanks.explanation_en: Dependent 'on' – standard preposition. 'Upon' is more formal but similar; 'on' is common.
blanks.explanation_bn: Dependent 'on' – মানক preposition। 'upon' আরও আনুষ্ঠানিক; 'on' সাধারণ।

blanks.explanation_en: Effect 'on' something – influence. 'Upon' also possible, 'in' inside, 'over' above.
blanks.explanation_bn: Effect 'on' something – প্রভাব। 'upon' সম্ভব, 'in' ভিতরে, 'over' উপরে।

blanks.explanation_en: Save us 'from' flood – protection against something. 'Of' possession, 'against' possible but less common, 'by' agent.
blanks.explanation_bn: Save us 'from' flood – থেকে রক্ষা। 'of' মালিকানা, 'against' বিরুদ্ধে, 'by' কর্তা।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Sleep is one of the most important factors (a) _____ human life. A sound man cannot go without sleeping. Sleep is the healing medicine (b) _____ the troubled people. It relieves physical and mental pain. Night is the proper time (c) _____ sleeping. But if a man has to pass a sleepless night, he never feels well. He loses energy and peace (d) _____ mind. As a result, he becomes indifferent (e) _____ his duties and responsibilities.

blanks.explanation_en: Factors 'in' human life – within the domain of life. 'Of' would mean factors belonging to life, also possible but 'in' is common.
blanks.explanation_bn: Factors 'in' human life – মানবজীবনের ক্ষেত্রে। 'of' দিলেও হয় তবে 'in' বেশি প্রচলিত।

blanks.explanation_en: Medicine 'for' people – intended to help them. 'To' indicates direction, 'of' possession.
blanks.explanation_bn: Medicine 'for' people – তাদের জন্য ওষুধ। 'to' দিক, 'of' মালিকানা।

blanks.explanation_en: Proper time 'for' sleeping – purpose. 'Of' would be 'time of sleeping' (when sleep occurs).
blanks.explanation_bn: Proper time 'for' sleeping – উদ্দেশ্য। 'of' দিলে 'ঘুমের সময়' হয় (যখন ঘুম হয়)।

blanks.explanation_en: Peace 'of' mind – fixed phrase. 'In' would be location, 'from' source.
blanks.explanation_bn: Peace 'of' mind – স্থির phrase। 'in' অবস্থান, 'from' উৎস।

blanks.explanation_en: Indifferent 'to' something – showing no interest. 'For' would be purpose, 'in' location.
blanks.explanation_bn: Indifferent 'to' something – উদাসীন হওয়া। 'for' উদ্দেশ্য, 'in' অবস্থান।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Trees are essential (a) _____ man in many ways. They provide us (b) _____ oxygen without which we cannot live more than a few minutes. They supply us (c) _____ vitamin and food, give us shade and help to prevent drought and flood. Unfortunately, we cannot realize the importance (d) _____ trees. We cut them indiscriminately in large numbers but it is a suicidal attempt. If we do not stop these acts, soon our country will, no doubt, turn (e) _____ a desert.

blanks.explanation_en: Essential 'to' – indicates necessity for someone. 'For' also possible but 'to' is more common with 'essential' when followed by a person.
blanks.explanation_bn: Essential 'to' – কারো জন্য প্রয়োজনীয়তা। 'for' সম্ভব তবে 'to' বেশি প্রচলিত।

blanks.explanation_en: Provide us 'with' oxygen – supply something to someone. 'For' would be 'provide for us' (take care).
blanks.explanation_bn: Provide us 'with' oxygen – কাউকে কিছু সরবরাহ করা। 'for' দিলে 'আমাদের জন্য জোগান' হয়।

blanks.explanation_en: Supply us 'with' – same pattern as 'provide with'.
blanks.explanation_bn: Supply us 'with' – 'provide with' এর মতো একই নিয়ম।
Importance 'of' trees – সম্বন্ধ বোঝায় (গাছের গুরুত্ব)।

blanks.explanation_en: Turn 'into' a desert – transformation (same as Q6b).
blanks.explanation_bn: Turn 'into' a desert – রূপান্তর (Q6b এর মতো)।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Truthfulness refers to the habit of speaking the truth. It is the greatest of all virtues (a) _____ a man's life. The true peace and prosperity of man entirely depends (b) _____ it. It ennobles one's character and gives one high position in society. It may not make one rich but brings peace (c) _____ mind. A truthful person is loved and respected (d) _____ all. A truthful person cares nobody. All religions teach us to be truthful. By dint (e) _____ truthfulness all can shine in life. Truthfulness can lead the whole world to peace and prosperity.

blanks.explanation_en: Virtues 'in' a man's life – within the span. 'Of' would be virtues belonging to life.
blanks.explanation_bn: Virtues 'in' a man's life – জীবনের মধ্যে। 'of' দিলে জীবনের গুণাবলি।
Depends 'on' – মানক। 'upon' আনুষ্ঠানিক।
Peace 'of' mind – স্থির phrase (Q7d মতো)।

blanks.explanation_en: Respected 'by' all – agent in passive voice.
blanks.explanation_bn: Respected 'by' all – passive voice-এ কর্তা।

blanks.explanation_en: By dint 'of' – fixed phrase meaning 'by means of'.
blanks.explanation_bn: By dint 'of' – স্থির phrase, অর্থ 'উপায়ে'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Once a farmer had great desire (a) _____ land. One day going to the landlord, he wanted some land where he might live (b) _____ comfort. The landlord was very wise. So he told him to have as much land as he could cover (c) _____ running till sun-set. The farmer became very pleased hearing that. Next morning he started running as early as he could to cover more area. He ran till evening and the sun was about to set. He ran (d) _____ his last strength but became very tired and fell down dead. He was buried there. Then the wise man remarked a man needs just as much land as will be enough (e) _____ his grave.

blanks.explanation_en: Desire 'for' something – strong wish. 'Of' would be 'desire of land' (less common).
blanks.explanation_bn: Desire 'for' something – প্রবল ইচ্ছা। 'of' দিলে কম প্রচলিত।

blanks.explanation_en: Live 'in' comfort – condition/state. 'With comfort' also possible but 'in' is idiomatic.
blanks.explanation_bn: Live 'in' comfort – অবস্থা। 'with comfort' সম্ভব তবে 'in' বেশি idiom।

blanks.explanation_en: Cover 'by' running – means/method. 'By' + gerund indicates method.
blanks.explanation_bn: Cover 'by' running – পদ্ধতি। 'by' + gerund পদ্ধতি বোঝায়।

blanks.explanation_en: Ran 'with' his last strength – using the last of his energy. 'By' would be method (by using), but 'with' is better.
blanks.explanation_bn: Ran 'with' his last strength – শেষ শক্তি ব্যবহার করে। 'by' পদ্ধতি তবে 'with' ভালো।

blanks.explanation_en: Enough 'for' his grave – sufficient purpose. 'Of' would be 'enough of his grave' (partial).
blanks.explanation_bn: Enough 'for' his grave – উদ্দেশ্যের জন্য যথেষ্ট। 'of' দিলে 'তার কবরের কিছু অংশ'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Housing is one of the greatest problems in our country. Thousands (a) _____ people in big cities like Dhaka and Chattogram live (b) _____ the footpaths. In rural areas there is also an acute crisis (c) _____ housing. The cost (d) _____ construction is increasing day by day. At present it is very difficult (e) _____ the poor people to bear the cost of construction. So, this problem needs to be solved soon.

blanks.explanation_bn: Thousands 'of' people – সংখ্যা প্রকাশ।

blanks.explanation_en: Live 'on' footpaths – surface (footpath as a surface). 'In' would be inside.
blanks.explanation_bn: Live 'on' footpaths – পৃষ্ঠে (ফুটপাত পৃষ্ঠ)। 'in' ভিতরে।

blanks.explanation_en: Crisis 'of' housing – type of crisis. 'In housing' also possible but 'of' is common.
blanks.explanation_bn: Crisis 'of' housing – সংকটের ধরন। 'in housing' সম্ভব তবে 'of' সাধারণ।
Cost 'of' construction – নির্মাণের খরচ।

blanks.explanation_en: Difficult 'for' the poor people – who experiences difficulty.
blanks.explanation_bn: Difficult 'for' the poor people – কার জন্য কঠিন।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Language plays a very important role (a) _____ the life of human beings. We use language (b) _____ the moment we wake (c) _____ in the morning until we go to bed at night. We use language for different purposes. We use language to express our ideas, thoughts and feelings, to convey our message or to pass our information (d) _____ others. In short, language is ever present in our activities. It is an inseparable part (e) _____ what we are, what we do and believe.

blanks.explanation_en: Role 'in' the life – within that sphere.
blanks.explanation_bn: Role 'in' the life – সেই পরিধির মধ্যে।

blanks.explanation_en: 'From the moment' – starting point. 'Since' is for a point in past, 'for' duration.
blanks.explanation_bn: 'From the moment' – শুরু বিন্দু। 'since' অতীতের বিন্দু, 'for' সময়কাল।

blanks.explanation_en: Wake 'up' – phrasal verb. Others change meaning.
blanks.explanation_bn: Wake 'up' – phrasal verb। অন্যগুলো অর্থ পরিবর্তন করে।

blanks.explanation_en: Pass information 'to' others – direction of transfer.
blanks.explanation_bn: Pass information 'to' others – স্থানান্তরের দিক।
Part 'of' – অংশ।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Reading textbook is essential (a) _____ all the students. A student cannot expect to make a good result until he or she reads textbooks. In the textbooks all the topics are designed as per students' grade that ensures a complete sense. In case of not reading those texts a student will miss topics needed for him or her. Moreover, textbooks are written and edited (b) _____ highly experienced educationists. Some students ignore to read textbooks rather they prefer guide books. But merely reading guide books keeps the students ignoble (c) _____ the subject-matter as they are written focusing (d) _____ exam result while a textbook covers all the details for holistic nourishment (e) _____ a student.

blanks.explanation_en: Essential 'for' someone – necessity. 'To' also possible but 'for' is more direct.
blanks.explanation_bn: Essential 'for' someone – প্রয়োজন। 'to' সম্ভব তবে 'for' বেশি সরাসরি।
Edited 'by' educationists – কর্তা।

blanks.explanation_en: Ignoble 'of' the subject-matter? Actually 'ignoble' is an adjective, but here 'keeps the students ignoble of' is unusual. However the answer given is 'of'. Could be 'ignorant of'? But text says 'ignoble' – possible misprint. We follow answer sheet: 'of'.
blanks.explanation_bn: এখানে 'keeps the students ignoble of' – অস্বাভাবিক। উত্তরপত্র অনুযায়ী 'of'। সম্ভবত 'ignorant of' হবে।
Focusing 'on' – মানক।
Nourishment 'of' a student – পুষ্টি যা ছাত্রের।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Road accident is a regular phenomenon in Bangladesh. Many people die (a) _____ road accidents every year. So it is considered a curse. Road accidents occur for various reasons. Many factors are responsible (b) _____ road accidents. The most common cause is reckless driving. Sometimes they drive night coach even (c) _____ the same day. The drivers do not check the engines regularly (d) _____ they start driving. The roads are two-lane roads without any dividers. These are some of the main reasons of road accidents (e) _____ Bangladesh.

blanks.explanation_en: Die 'by' accident – cause or means. 'From' also possible (die from a disease), but 'by accident' is idiom.
blanks.explanation_bn: Die 'by' accident – কারণে। 'from' দিয়েও হয় (রোগে মরা), কিন্তু 'by accident' idiom।
Responsible 'for' – দায়ী।

blanks.explanation_en: On the same day – specific day. 'In' would be longer periods.
blanks.explanation_bn: On the same day – নির্দিষ্ট দিন। 'in' বড় সময়ের জন্য।

blanks.explanation_en: Before they start driving – time sequence. Others change meaning.
blanks.explanation_bn: Before they start driving – সময় ক্রম। অন্যগুলো অর্থ পরিবর্তন করে।
Reasons of accidents 'in' Bangladesh – অবস্থান (দেশ)।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: A true friend is an asset. He stands beside his friends in time (a) _____ danger. He is not a greedy person. He always wishes (b) _____ the welfare (c) _____ his friend. But it is a matter (d) _____ regret that a true friend is very rare today. A selfish man cannot be a true friend. He always thinks (e) _____ his own interest.

blanks.explanation_en: Time 'of' danger – period characterized by danger.
blanks.explanation_bn: Time 'of' danger – বিপদের সময়।

blanks.explanation_en: Wishes 'for' the welfare – expresses hope/desire for something.
blanks.explanation_bn: Wishes 'for' the welfare – কল্যাণ কামনা করা।
Welfare 'of' his friend – বন্ধুর কল্যাণ।
Matter 'of' regret – দুঃখের বিষয়।

blanks.explanation_en: Thinks 'of' his own interest – considers. 'About' also possible but 'of' is given.
blanks.explanation_bn: Thinks 'of' his own interest – বিবেচনা করে। 'about' সম্ভব তবে উত্তর 'of'।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Now-a-days, the young farmers (a) _____ our country are showing interest to cultivate foreign vegetables. They, with their innovative power, have added new dimensions (b) _____ the country's agricultural sector. Karim Ullah is such a farmer. Five years ago, he started his farm (c) _____ a determination and challenge. Now he owns a vegetable farm where he cultivates curry leaves, lemon grass, broccoli and other foreign vegetables. The cultivation of foreign crops in our country is very inspiring (d) _____ both the farmers and the customers as it brings diversity in our regular food and nutrition. It is also possible to export vegetables (e) _____ ensuring quality production and packaging.

blanks.explanation_bn: Farmers 'of' our country – আমাদের দেশের কৃষক।
Added dimensions 'to' – সংযোজনের দিক।
Started 'with' determination – সঙ্গে নিয়ে।
Inspiring 'for' both – তাদের জন্য অনুপ্রেরণাদায়ক।
Export 'by' ensuring – পদ্ধতি (by + gerund)।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Scientists have recently reported that the surface ice caps are melting. This is due (a) _____ a rise in atmospheric temperature known as the greenhouse effect. According (b) _____ the scientists carbon dioxide is primarily responsible (c) _____ temperature rise in atmosphere. The carbon dioxide is high when coal and oil are burnt. The gas is accumulating in the atmosphere and causing the temperature to rise. As a result, the polar ice (d) _____ the North and South poles is melting. We should maintain the ecological balance (e) _____ the environment.

blanks.explanation_bn: Due 'to' – কারণে।
According 'to' – স্থির phrase।
Responsible 'for' – Q14b এর মতো।

blanks.explanation_en: Ice 'in' the North and South poles – location within those regions.
blanks.explanation_bn: Ice 'in' the North and South poles – সেই অঞ্চলের ভিতরে।
Balance 'of' the environment – পরিবেশের ভারসাম্য।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Modern civilization is the blessing of science. Science has worked like a magician in the world. We can't do even a single day (a) _____ the help of science. Many quick means (b) _____ communication like telephone, telex, fax, telegram, satellite etc. are the greatest wonders of science. Nowadays a message can be sent from one corner of the world (c) _____ another in the twinkle of an eye. Science has brought a revolutionary change (d) _____ all fields. In the field of medical science blind has got eyes, lame has got legs, deaf has got hearing power. The diseases which were incurable (e) _____ the past are now easily cured.

blanks.explanation_bn: Can't do 'without' – ছাড়া।
Means 'of' communication – যোগাযোগের মাধ্যম।
From one ... 'to' another – এক থেকে অপর।
Change 'in' all fields – সব ক্ষেত্রে।
Incurable 'in' the past – অতীতে।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Diligence means an effort to perform a work successfully. God has given us two hands to work. (a) _____ the beginning (b) _____ the world, human beings have been struggling (c) _____ nature to keep hold (d) _____ their existence. If they did not struggle, they might have perished long ago. Thus we see that diligence is inevitable (e) _____ our personal, social and national life. The student who is more diligent, makes a better result than those who are not. So, to be successful everybody should be diligent.

blanks.explanation_en: 'From the beginning' – starting point. Capitalised as per answer sheet (though not necessary in gap).
blanks.explanation_bn: 'From the beginning' – শুরু থেকে। উত্তরপত্রে বড় হাতের দেওয়া আছে।
Beginning 'of' the world – জগতের শুরু।
Struggling 'with' nature – প্রকৃতির সাথে সংগ্রাম।
Hold 'of' their existence – অস্তিত্বের নিয়ন্ত্রণ।
Inevitable 'in' life – জীবনে অনিবার্য।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: People are fond (a) _____ travelling. So, travelling has been popular with man from time immemorial. It is the romance (b) _____ seeing the unseen, knowing the unknown and unveiling the shrouds of mystery. A man hardly knows his own land completely until he has gone (c) _____ of it to travel other countries. Only a rational comparison of our country (d) _____ other countries can vividly specify the true nature of merits and demerits of our own motherland. An awareness of our defects inspires us to work hard and improve the unhappy condition (e) _____ our dear native place.

blanks.explanation_bn: Fond 'of' – পছন্দ।
Romance 'of' seeing – দেখার রোমান্স।
Gone 'out of' it – বাইরে যাওয়া।
Comparison 'with' – তুলনা।
Condition 'of' native place – নিজ জন্মভূমির অবস্থা।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Education is one (a) _____ the basic needs of a human being and is essential (b) _____ every kind of development. It enables us to make right choices (c) _____ life. It enhances our ability to raise crops, store food, protect the environment and carry (d) _____ our social responsibilities. It provides us with an enlightened awareness about things. But education has to be defined. It is not merely getting degrees (e) _____ schools, colleges and universities. It is something more lasting, more humane.

blanks.explanation_en: One 'of' the basic needs – part of a group.
blanks.explanation_bn: One 'of' the basic needs – একটি মৌলিক চাহিদা।
Essential 'for' development – উন্নয়নের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয়।
Choices 'in' life – জীবনে পছন্দ।
Carry 'out' responsibilities – পালন করা।
Getting degrees 'from' institutions – প্রতিষ্ঠান থেকে ডিগ্রি।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Patriotism is an inherent quality of human being. It creates in a man a feeling of love (a) _____ his motherland. It is older than civilization. The man who loves his own country, does his first and foremost duties and works (b) _____ the welfare and development (c) _____ his country, is a patriot. Even the ancient tribes had a great love for the land where they were born and sacrificed their lives to defend it. If he does it and performs his duties honestly and sincerely in his own fields, he can be a patriot. If he does not do so, he will be a traitor. We must not have bitterness (d) _____ anyone. But narrow patriotism is very bad. All should cut it off (e) _____ their hearts.

blanks.explanation_bn: Love 'for' motherland – মাতৃভূমির প্রতি ভালোবাসা।
Works 'for' welfare – কল্যাণের জন্য কাজ করে।
Development 'of' country – দেশের উন্নয়ন।
Bitterness 'towards' anyone – কারো প্রতি তিক্ততা।

blanks.explanation_en: Cut off 'from' their hearts – remove from.
blanks.explanation_bn: Cut off 'from' their hearts – হৃদয় থেকে সরিয়ে ফেলা।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Adopting unfair means (a) _____ the examination is an offence. It degrades the standard of education. If the students (b) _____ our country do not acquire true education, there will be no development (c) _____ the country. An examinee should study seriously so that he can cut a good figure (d) _____ the examination. To acquire true education should be the only aim in the lives of all students. An educated man cannot support adopting any unfair means (e) _____ the examination at all.

blanks.explanation_en: Unfair means 'in' the examination – within the exam context.
blanks.explanation_bn: Unfair means 'in' the examination – পরীক্ষায় অসদুপায়।
Students 'of' our country – আমাদের দেশের ছাত্ররা।
Development 'for' the country – দেশের জন্য উন্নয়ন।

blanks.explanation_en: Cut a good figure 'in' the examination – perform well in.
blanks.explanation_bn: Cut a good figure 'in' the examination – পরীক্ষায় ভালো করা।

blanks.explanation_en: Unfair means 'in' the examination – same as (a).
blanks.explanation_bn: Unfair means 'in' the examination – (a) এর মতো।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Terrorism is a great threat and major concern (a) _____ almost all the countries. Terrorists cause damage (b) _____ human lives and properties creating panic and terror. The cause of terrorism is mainly related (c) _____ the deprivation of genuine rights and also greed and exploitation (d) _____ different groups and nations. To get rid (e) _____ terrorism is very difficult but not impossible if the intellectuals and peace loving nations work unitedly.

blanks.explanation_bn: Concern 'for' countries – দেশগুলোর জন্য উদ্বেগ।
Damage 'to' lives – ক্ষতি যা জীবনের দিকে।
Related 'to' – সম্পর্কিত।

blanks.explanation_en: Exploitation 'of' groups – done by? Actually 'exploitation of' means they are exploited. Here it fits.
blanks.explanation_bn: Exploitation 'of' groups – গোষ্ঠীগুলোর শোষণ।
Get rid 'of' – মুক্তি পাওয়া।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: December 16, our Victory Day, is a significant event (a) _____ our national history. The day is the perpetual source of our strength and energy. The day reminds us (b) _____ the supreme sacrifices of our sons for the noble cause and also inspires us to sacrifice ourselves (c) _____ our beloved country. The day is a clear warning (d) _____ the oppressors that people's right can never be prevented for long and that oppressors will always be defeated because there is nothing more powerful than people's will (e) _____ freedom. It gives us the message that 'Man can be subjugated but can never be defeated.'

blanks.explanation_bn: Event 'in' history – ইতিহাসে ঘটনা।
Reminds us 'of' – স্মরণ করিয়ে দেয়।

blanks.explanation_en: Sacrifice ourselves 'for' country – on behalf of.
blanks.explanation_bn: Sacrifice ourselves 'for' country – দেশের জন্য আত্মাহুতি।
Warning 'for' oppressors – অত্যাচারীদের জন্য সতর্কবার্তা।
Will 'for' freedom – স্বাধীনতার ইচ্ছা।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Nowadays a good number of farmers are getting benefits from the organic cultivation (a) _____ vegetables. Vermicompost, called organic fertilizer made mainly from cowdung and earthworm is used (b) _____ the farmers. As the farmers did not use any chemical fertilizer or pesticides (c) _____ their vegetable beds, the production cost has come down. It takes about fifty thousand taka to prepare an acre of land and the harvest starts within forty-five days since planting. Due (d) _____ good yield of the crop, some temporary warehouses have been made (e) _____ surrounding area. So proper use of organic fertilizer can change the scenario of our agricultural sector.

blanks.explanation_bn: Cultivation 'of' vegetables – সবজি চাষ।
Used 'by' farmers – কৃষকদের দ্বারা ব্যবহৃত।
On their vegetable beds – সবজি বেডের ওপর।
Due 'to' – কারণে।
Made 'in' surrounding area – আশেপাশের এলাকায় তৈরি।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Students teachers' relationship is regarded as the relationship (a) _____ parents and children. A teacher is next (b) _____ parents. Parents bring up children. On the other hand, a teacher guides the students to materialize their dreams. A teacher spreads the light of education to remove the darkness (c) _____ ignorance. As a result, a student can see the path of prosperity. Thus a teacher helps build (d) _____ a civilized nation. So he is really called the architect (e) _____ a nation.

blanks.explanation_bn: Relationship 'between' – দুই পক্ষের মধ্যে সম্পর্ক।
Next 'to' – পরে অবস্থান।
Darkness 'of' ignorance – অজ্ঞতার অন্ধকার।
Build 'up' – গড়ে তোলা।

blanks.explanation_en: Architect 'of' a nation – same as Q2a.
blanks.explanation_bn: Architect 'of' a nation – জাতির স্থপতি।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: The Padma multi-purpose bridge has started a new era (a) _____ the history of Bangladesh. This mega project has been implemented (b) _____ any foreign aid. The southern 21 districts were cut off from the main-land (c) _____ the mighty Padma river. So, this vast area could not keep pace with the other parts considering economic development. But direct connection (d) _____ the capital by this bridge is going to expand trade and commerce. Besides, tourism is also going to speed up. All these are contributing much (e) _____ our economic growth and surely reduce the poverty of those districts. The construction of the bridge which was our long-cherished dream at last came true.

blanks.explanation_bn: New era 'in' history – ইতিহাসে নতুন যুগ।
Implemented 'without' any foreign aid – কোনো বিদেশি সাহায্য ছাড়া বাস্তবায়িত।

blanks.explanation_en: Cut off 'by' the river – agent (the river).
blanks.explanation_bn: Cut off 'by' the river – নদী দ্বারা বিচ্ছিন্ন।
Connection 'with' the capital – রাজধানীর সাথে সংযোগ।
Contributing 'to' growth – উন্নয়নে অবদান।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: The earth is a vast planet. It is round in shape. One third of its total area is land while the other three portions are covered (a) _____ water. The water areas are divided (b) _____ oceans, seas and rivers. The surface of the land area is full of variety. There are high hills, green forests and stretches of deserts. The land mass is divided into some continents. Under each continent, there are a number of countries. The interior of the earth is abundant in mineral resources. There is existence of life only (c) _____ the earth. But, this existence of life would be impossible (d) _____ sunlight. In fact, sunlight is the prerequisite (e) _____ the existence of all types of living beings.

blanks.explanation_bn: Covered 'with' water – জল দিয়ে আবৃত।
Divided 'into' – ভাগ করা।
Life only 'on' the earth – পৃথিবীর ওপর।
Impossible 'without' sunlight – সূর্যালোক ছাড়া অসম্ভব।
Prerequisite 'for' existence – অস্তিত্বের জন্য পূর্বশর্ত।

source: An Exercise Book on English for Today Classes 9-10 (SSC Exam Preparation)
passage: Man is a social being. So he lives (a) _____ a society. Mutual understanding and cooperation are needed to ensure a peaceful society. To produce ideal members (b) _____ a society, an ideal family contributes a lot. A child's future behaviour is greatly influenced (c) _____ the culture of his family. If a child is born and brought (d) _____ in a rude and chaotic environment, he also becomes rude (e) _____ behaviour and creates chaos and indiscipline in the society.

blanks.explanation_bn: Lives 'in' a society – সমাজে বাস করে।
Members 'of' a society – সমাজের সদস্য।
Influenced 'by' – দ্বারা প্রভাবিত।
Brought 'up' – লালিত-পালিত।
Rude 'in' behaviour – আচরণে অভদ্র।
